d: Using two pointers moving at different speeds to detect cycles or find midpoints.
c: Linked List Cycle II (Find cycle start)

p: Floyd's Cycle Finding Algorithm uses two pointers moving at different speeds (usually 1x and 2x). If there is a cycle, the fast pointer will eventually 'lap' the slow pointer and they will meet.

def hasCycle(head):
  slow, fast = head, head
  while fast and fast.next:
    slow = slow.next
    fast = fast.next.next
    if slow == fast:
      return True
  return False
Time: O(N) to traverse or find cycle. Space: O(1).

(Slow)
        ↓
(1) -> (2) -> (3)
        ↑      |
      (5) <- (4)
        ↑
      (Fast)
Fast moves 2x, Slow moves 1x. They meet at (5)!
